correctness.rationale: For every prime divisor p>3, Newton identities invert 2 and 3 and show that equality of the first three power sums is equivalent to equality of the unordered triple. The three multiplicity types give exactly 36*C(p,3)+9*p*(p-1)+p = p*(6*p^2-9*p+4) ordered pairs. Squarefreeness makes the congruence system multiplicative by the Chinese remainder theorem. Substitution into the published exact moment/synthesis identity gives the stated constant. The endpoint criterion follows because every local factor lies between 109/25 and 6. The packaged verifier exhaustively confirms the local count for p=5,7,11 and checks representative CRT products.
